approvers: Tax adviser, M&A broker, notary, house bank, my family
reason: A newly formed Belize shell with no track record and no committed funding wants my life's work. My bank, tax adviser and notary would laugh me out of the room, and I would not risk my staff on it.
objection: Belize, no track record, no money committed yet. I cannot tell whether this buyer exists in two years, and 30% deferred over three years is paid by a company I cannot check.
instead: Keep running the business, let my adviser run a proper sale process, list on nexxt-change, and talk to strategic buyers or a known Mittelstand holding with references and proof of funds.
would_change_my_mind: Proof of funds in a German bank escrow before any talks, a German or EU entity with named backers, references from previous acquisitions, and the deferred part secured by a bank guarantee.
